map.入射光必须线偏振吗？: Must the incident light be linearly polarised?
map.是；自然光先经起偏片变为线偏振，再对检偏片用马吕斯定律。: Yes; natural light first passes through a polariser to become linearly polarised, and only then is Malus's law applied with the analyser.
map.I0 是起偏前还是后？: Is I0 before or after polarisation?
map.I0 指入射到检偏片的线偏振光强（通常已是起偏后的一半自然光强）。: I0 refers to the linearly polarised intensity arriving at the analyser (typically half the natural light intensity after polarisation).
